question: What does unverified mean for the 258 merged branches blocked on PR check, and what is real prune reach if gh works?
arming: BLOCKED pending operator acceptance of this analysis

codeSemantics.verified_true: gh pr list succeeded in repo cwd — open PR heads known (may be empty set)
codeSemantics.verified_false: gh pr list threw — CANNOT reach PR API; empty heads assumed; every merged branch gets deleteBlockedReason open_pr_check_unverified
codeSemantics.notUsed: Unverified does NOT mean 'branch has no associated pull request'. Absence of open PR is openPrHead=false with verified=true.

case1_cannotReachPrData.conclusion: 258 is a tooling/API reach failure during the long batch scan, not a finding about branch merge history. Intermittent GraphQL EOF on LDT; ET likely transient failure in same batch window.

case2_reachableNoOpenPr.note: When gh works, empty open PR list is verified=true with openPrHead=false — branches proceed to declaration/worktree signals. Not counted as unverified.

case3_mix.note: Not a mix of case 1 and 2 at branch level. Fleet scan was case 1 for two whole repos. When case 1 clears, branches rebucket into excludedBySafetySignal with real reasons.

byRepo.note: No LDT branches in branch_declarations.json. Fail-closed undeclared dominates.
Markets-declared prune-safe branches (tw44a–tw66 etc.) blocked by worktree_attached, not PR check.

operatorConclusion.armedFirstRunBehavior: Would delete 1 of 259 merged candidates in current estate — not 258. The 258 figure misreports gh API failure as branch-level PR ambiguity.
operatorConclusion.reason: Real gates are (1) branch_declarations.json fail-closed undeclared/unknown/live, (2) worktree attachment on declared prune-safe, (3) intermittent gh GraphQL for LDT.
